Subject: Discovery follow-up & VP/CTO intro - scheduling exec alignment

Hi Michael / Asha,

Thanks again for taking the time today - really appreciate the thoughtful questions and the background on Zenlyx's latency-sensitive inference workloads. Quick recap from our side:

- Primary use case: real-time summarization for clinical notes at ~300 TPS, 2-3k token sequences
- Key requirements: <10ms p95 response for short paths, audit logs, and SOC2 evidence for pilot
- Current blockers: exec alignment (VP/CTO) for procurement and capacity commit; need to confirm SLA expectations and pricing envelope

Next steps I mentioned on the call:
1) Schedule a short exec alignment (VP/CTO) so we can get leadership buy-in and finalize the mutual action plan (MAP).
2) Follow up with a scoped pilot proposal and cost estimate based on the call metrics.

Do you have 30 minutes next week for an executive intro with our VP Product (I can also include our CTO if helpful) to review the MAP and high-level SOW? Suggested windows: Tue 6/29 or Wed 6/30 between 10:00-12:30 PT. If those don't work, send a couple of times that do and I will coordinate.

Attached is a first-draft MAP (Zenlyx-MAP-v1.pdf) that outlines milestones and decision points - happy to iterate.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142
